title: Prime Minister congratulates Satnam Singh and Salman Khan on winning Bronze medal in Men’s Double Sculls
body_text:
Prime Minister Shri Narendra Modi today congratulated Satnam Singh and Salman Khan on their fine performance in the Men’s Double Sculls, which earned India a well-deserved Bronze medal.
The Prime Minister stated that their composure and coordination stood out. He further expressed his hope that this achievement will inspire them to scale even greater heights in the years ahead.
In a post on X, the Prime Minister's Office shared:
"A fine performance by Satnam Singh and Salman Khan in the Men’s Double Sculls, earning India a well-deserved Bronze medal.
Their composure and coordination stood out. May this achievement inspire them to scale even greater heights in the years ahead: PM @narendramodi"
